note: Example for Settings, Import Custom Keys. Open settings, Controls page sends Ctrl+, (the common settings shortcut), waits 1 s for the window, moves the keyboard focus back twice with Shift+Tab to the page list and selects its last entry with End. The number of Shift+Tab steps depends on the app and its version: add one if the focus stops short, remove one if it goes too far. keys holds the first combination for the on-screen keyboard.
